changelog.body:
## What's New in v1.0.0 🎉

The first stable release of AA Experiments is here! This update focuses on reliability, performance, and UI improvements.

- **Improved scanning:** More reliable Android Auto analysis, even when switching apps or turning off the screen.
- **Media auto-open:** Improved automatic launching of Spotify or other selected media apps, with more reliable route detection.
- **Refreshed UI:** Polished light and dark themes, better colors, clearer status indicators, and improved navigation.
- **Better compatibility:** More resilient feature detection across Android Auto updates and improved APK/APKM handling.
- **Safer overrides:** Improved configuration persistence, recovery, and handling of suspended experiments.
- **Performance & stability:** Optimized catalog storage, database handling, and memory usage.
- **Bug fixes:** Various fixes, accessibility improvements, and internal cleanups.

This release builds on beta5 and brings the improvements developed throughout beta6 into a stable version.

changelog.name: 1.0.0-beta5
changelog.body:
## What's new

- **Automatic Media Startup**: optionally open the media app currently selected in Android Auto when projection starts.
- Two dynamically resolved launch routes: Auxiliary (A) and Direct (B).
- Dedicated Media settings page with explicit per-build opt-in.
- Session safeguards to prevent duplicate launches and cancel pending actions on navigation or disconnection.
- Compatibility checks reject ambiguous or unsupported Android Auto builds.
- Preserves existing experiment overrides, Advanced Overrides, and backup/recovery functionality.

Automatic media startup is disabled by default and _may_ not start audio playback.

Source and full release notes: https://github.com/HighwindBR/AA-Experiments/releases/tag/v1.0.0-beta5

# AA Experiments

**AA Experiments** is an independent, open-source **LSPosed module and Android manager** for discovering, inspecting and selectively overriding Android Auto experiment flags.

The manager analyzes installed or imported Android Auto APK/APKM/APKS packages locally. It identifies compatible scalar getters and only publishes active overrides for the exact installed base/split build fingerprint. It does not patch, resign, install or redistribute Android Auto.

## Features

- Search and inspect discovered **Android Auto experiment flags**.
- Configure eligible **BOOLEAN, LONG, DOUBLE and STRING overrides**.
- Optional Advanced Overrides for a separately reviewed subset of getters, with explicit risk warnings, two-stage confirmation and Pause / Resume / Restore.
- View read-only getter probes and Video Timing Controller diagnostics.
- Export large catalogs as JSON or CSV and preserve normal, Advanced and Experimental settings in an exact-build recovery bundle.
- Review or suspend incompatible mappings rather than silently applying them after Android Auto updates.
- Option in Settings → Media to **automatic media-app opening** when Android Auto projection starts.

## Requirements

- Android 8.1 / API 27 or newer.
- A compatible LSPosed framework providing libxposed API 101.
- Android Auto installed; scope the module to `com.google.android.projection.gearhead` in LSPosed.

## Installation

1. Download the official, release-key-signed APK from [Xposed Module Repo](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/io.github.highwindbr.aaxp/releases) or from developer repo [**AA Experiments** Releases](https://github.com/HighwindBR/AA-Experiments/releases).
2. Install the APK and enable **AA Experiments** in LSPosed.
3. Confirm if **Android Auto** is selected in the module's LSPosed scope.
4. Restart Android Auto process as needed and open **AA Experiments** to analyze installed build.
5. Make changes deliberately; no flags are overridden by default. Keep a backup and use the built-in Restore controls if you experience issues.

## Safety and privacy

Eligible getters are not guaranteed to make a feature work: the Android Auto app, Google servers and the connected head unit may impose additional conditions. Advanced entries are **not** universally editable, and some values can affect stability or safety. Full recovery backups are **not encrypted or authenticated**, may include raw STRING values and should be kept private; use only matching-build backups from trusted sources.

Scans and analysis run locally. The application has no developer-operated backend or telemetry. See the main project's [privacy](https://github.com/HighwindBR/AA-Experiments/blob/main/PRIVACY.md) and [known limitations](https://github.com/HighwindBR/AA-Experiments/blob/main/docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md) for details.

## Links

- [**Source, documentation and support**](https://github.com/HighwindBR/AA-Experiments)
- [**Feature catalog**](https://github.com/HighwindBR/AA-Experiments/blob/main/FEATURE_CATALOG.md)
- [**Official APK releases**](https://github.com/HighwindBR/AA-Experiments/releases)

**Application ID:** `io.github.highwindbr.aaxp`
**License:** GPL-3.0-or-later
**Author:** HighwindBR

This is an independent project and is not affiliated with Google, Android Auto or LSPosed.

# AA 实验

**AA Experiments** 是一个独立的开源 **LSPosed 模块和 Android 管理器**，用于发现、检查和有选择地覆盖 Android Auto 实验标志。

管理器分析本地安装或导入的 Android Auto APK/APKM/APKS 包。它识别兼容的标量 getter，并且仅发布针对确切安装的基础/拆分构建指纹的活动覆盖。它不会修补、退出、安装或重新分发 Android Auto。

## 特点

- 搜索并检查发现的 **Android Auto 实验标志**。
- 配置符合条件的 **BOOLEAN、LONG、DOUBLE 和 STRING 覆盖**。
- 可选的高级覆盖，用于单独审查的 getter 子集，具有明确的风险警告、两阶段确认和暂停/恢复/恢复。
- 查看只读吸气剂探针和视频定时控制器诊断。
- 将大型目录导出为 JSON 或 CSV，并在精确构建的恢复包中保留正常、高级和实验设置。
- 检查或暂停不兼容的映射，而不是在 Android Auto 更新后默默应用它们。
- 设置 → 媒体中的选项可在 Android Auto 投影启动时**自动打开媒体应用程序**。

## 要求

- Android 8.1 / API 27 或更高版本。
- 兼容的 LSPod 框架提供 libxposed API 101。
- 安装Android Auto；将模块范围限定为 LSPosed 中的“com.google.android.projection.gearhead”。

## 安装

1. 从 [Xposed Module Repo](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/io.github.highwindbr.aaxp/releases) 或开发人员存储库 [**AA Experiments** Releases](https://github.com/HighwindBR/AA-Experiments/releases) 下载官方的、发布密钥签名的 APK。
2. 安装 APK 并在 LSPod 中启用 **AA 实验**。
3. 确认是否在模块的 LSPosed 范围中选择了 **Android Auto**。
4. 根据需要重新启动 Android Auto 进程并打开 **AA Experiments** 来分析已安装的版本。
5、有意识地做出改变；默认情况下没有覆盖任何标志。如果遇到问题，请保留备份并使用内置的恢复控件。

## 安全和隐私

不保证符合条件的获取者能够使某项功能发挥作用：Android Auto 应用程序、Google 服务器和连接的主机可能会施加额外的条件。高级条目**不**普遍可编辑，并且某些值可能会影响稳定性或安全性。完整恢复备份**未加密或经过身份验证**，可能包含原始字符串值，应保密；仅使用来自可信来源的匹配构建备份。

扫描和分析在本地运行。该应用程序没有开发人员操作的后端或遥测。有关详细信息，请参阅主项目的[隐私](https://github.com/HighwindBR/AA-Experiments/blob/main/PRIVACY.md) 和[已知限制](https://github.com/HighwindBR/AA-Experiments/blob/main/docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md)。

## 链接

- [**来源、文档和支持**](https://github.com/HighwindBR/AA-Experiments)
- [**功能目录**](https://github.com/HighwindBR/AA-Experiments/blob/main/FEATURE_CATALOG.md)
- [**官方 APK 版本**](https://github.com/HighwindBR/AA-Experiments/releases)

**许可证：** GPL-3.0 或更高版本
**作者：** HighwindBR

这是一个独立项目，不隶属于 Google、Android Auto 或 LSPod。
